metadata.title: Orthogonal partition by four hyperplanes
metadata.abstract: We study orthogonal $(4,3)$-equipartitions of finite measures absolutely continuous with respect to Lebesgue measure: every three of four mutually orthogonal affine hyperplanes must divide each measure into eight equal parts. For every number $m$ of measures, we determine the exact dimension threshold of Musin's polynomial criterion and express it in terms of the binary expansion of $m$. The threshold coincides with the geometric lower bound precisely when $m=2^j-1$. Consequently, $\Delta^*(2^j-1,4,3)=7\cdot2^{j-1}-2$ for every $j\geq1$.

analysis.workSummary: 研究四个相互正交仿射超平面中任意三个都把每个测度分为八等份的等分问题，给出 Musin 多项式判据关于测度数 m 的精确维数阈值，并在 m=2^j−1 时达到几何下界。
analysis.breakthrough: 在特定无限测度数族上得到精确等分维数 Δ*=7·2^(j−1)−2。
analysis.limitations: 依据官方标题、摘要及作者评论的摘要级分析，尚未审读数学证明。所有 m 的判据阈值不等于所有 m 的几何最优维数；摘要只在指定族上确认两者相同。 AI 披露以独立全文核查记录为准。
